name: Lesser Retribution
description:
These effects may be invoked with your Retributive Curses ability:

Bloodguilt. The first time on a turn that the creature deals damage to another creature, it takes 1d6+BODY damage and checks a Condition.

Leaden Shoes. The creature's speed is reduced to 5 ft and it can’t make opportunity attacks.

Uncanny Jinx. The creature takes -1d to all skill checks.

Vengeful Gleam. The target glows with a green witch-light. It can’t benefit from magical effects that obscure it, alter its appearance or make invisible, and attacks against it are favored if the attacker can see it.
